source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of paper chromatography (PDF 179).

blocks.text: Paper chromatography solvent ke zariye mixture ko us ke ajza mein alag karti hai; alag hona ajza ki nisbati hall pazeeri par munhasir hai. Kaghaz mein us ke cellulose ka thama hua paani hota hai. Sample ka chhota sa dhabba capillary tube se kaghaz ke neeche pencil ki baseline par lagaya jata, aur kaghaz munasib solvent mein duboya jata hai jo kaghaz mein charhta hai; solvent ki satah dhabbe se neeche honi chahiye. Sample ke maadde solvent mein mukhtalif had tak ghulte hain: kuch solvent (mobile phase) mein zyada ghul kar kaghaz par oopar jate, jab ke doosre kaghaz mein phanse paani (stationary phase) mein behtar ghulte aur door nahi jate. Hall pazeeri ka yeh farq ajza ko alag karta hai.

blocks.alt: Dhakkan wala tank; kaghaz ki sheet solvent mein latki hai. Sample ka dhabba baseline par hai, tajurbe ke shuru mein solvent ki satah se oopar. Is ke oopar teen alag ajza A, B aur C, tooti lakeer wale solvent front se neeche. Labels: lid, solvent front, components, baseline, solvent level at the start of experiment, solvent.
blocks.caption: Figure 28.2: Paper chromatography (kitab ki Figure 28.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Chromatography rangeen aur be-rang dono maadde alag karti hai; be-rang maadde unhein rang dene wale locating agent ke spray se nazar aane wale banaye jate hain. Chromatography ka aik faida yeh hai ke is ke liye mixture ki bohat thori miqdar chahiye.

blocks.title: Rf qeemat
blocks.text: Kisi maadde ki Rf qeemat (retardation factor) maadde ke tay kardah faasle ko solvent (solvent front) ke tay kardah faasle se taqseem karna hai, dono baseline se nape gaye: Rf = x / y. Yeh tanasub hai is liye is ki koi ikaai nahi, aur yeh yaksan halaat (wahi solvent aur darja hararat) mein nahi badalti.

blocks.alt: Tayyar kaghaz ki patti: neeche ki lakeer par starting point, oopar aik dhabba, aur oopar ke qareeb solvent front. Saath mein X starting point se dhabbe tak ka faasla aur Y starting point se solvent front tak ka faasla hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 28.3: Dhabbe aur solvent front ka faasla napna (kitab ki Figure 28.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rf = X / Y: X starting point se dhabbe tak aur Y starting point se solvent front tak ka faasla hai. Dhabba kabhi solvent front se aage nahi jata, is liye Rf hamesha 1 se kam hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Rf qeemat kabhi 1 se zyada kyun nahi ho sakti?
blocks.explanation: Maadda solvent ke saath chalta hai, is liye solvent front se aage nahi ja sakta: x hamesha y se kam ya barabar hai.

blocks.prompt: Baseline pencil se kyun banayi jati aur solvent ki satah dhabbon se neeche kyun honi chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Pencil (graphite) roshnai ke baraks solvent mein nahi ghulti ya behti; agar solvent dhabbon ko dhak le to sample kaghaz par charhne ki bajaye tank ke solvent mein ghul jayega.

items: Paper: stationary phase = kaghaz mein paani; mobile phase = solvent.
Rf = dhabbe ka faasla / solvent front ka faasla; koi ikaai nahi; yaksan halaat mein qaim.
